'''RAK-5 serum''' was a serum developed by Doctor [[Rahser Poth]] from the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]].

==History==
Around [[3629 BBY]]<ref name="Date" /> [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Alirra Semhess]] led a rogue group of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] to work on a secret project on the [[X7-Cratus]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]]. Falsely obtaining funding from a Republic endowment for disease research and treatment development, the group instead worked on developing experimental [[Adrenal/Legends|adrenals]]. Doctor [[Rahser Poth]] received encrypted communications fron an anonymous scientist that allowed him to develop RAK-5 serum, which in turn was refined into the [[RS-33]] [[Adrenal/Legends|adrenal]].<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=codex|Alliance Intelligence Report: RS-33 Adrenal}}</ref> The adrenal greatly enhanced subject's strength and agility at the expense of mental faculties, but the fact that both RAK-5 and RS-33 were derived from the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]] put them into highly unstable state.<ref name="Trial" />

[[Eternal Alliance]] [[operative]]s under [[Theron Shan]] eventually discovered Semhess and her project and a strike team was dispatched to X7-Cratus to stop RS-33 from becoming a galactic threat. Semhess attempted to use RS-33 enhanced subjects to stop the invaders, but during their fight with [[Marlon Fenn]] the station's containment systems were damaged and RAK-5 serum started leaking into the atmosphere. It soon turned both RS-33 test subjects and station personnel into [[rakghoul]]s. After killing Alirra Semhess, the Eternal Alliance secured the station's containment systems and put an end to the project.<ref name="Trial" />
